Task 1: Gateway crate, core GatewayHandler trait, IncomingMessage/OutgoingMessage/Attachment/ChatState types, and workspace registration are present in crates/gateway.
Task 2: GatewayManager supports registration, unregistration, event routing, broadcast, lifecycle start/stop, and logs detached task errors via GPUI TaskExt. Added manager routing/broadcast tests.
Task 3: Telegram gateway supports getUpdates polling, sendMessage, text/caption conversion, and Telegram photo/document/audio/voice attachment mapping. Added Telegram conversion tests.
Task 4: TelegramFormatter converts markdown to Telegram-compatible HTML and splits long messages; unit and integration tests cover formatting and length limits.
Task 5: PairingService supports persistent platform-user links, lookup, unlink, and duplicate protection with unit/integration coverage.

Task 6: app startup loads gateway config from paths::config_dir()/gateway.json plus env overrides and initializes a global GatewayManager; CLI start writes that config file, and status/help report the path.

Task 7: Gateway tests now cover manager registration/routing/broadcast/error continuation, Telegram update conversion/media mapping, mock Telegram getUpdates/sendMessage API success and error paths, formatter/pairing behavior, and a mock-agent round trip.
Task 1: Added crates/eval_harbor with serializable ScenarioDefinition/ScenarioStep/ExpectedOutcome types, EvalRunner scenario loading/execution, AssertionEngine validation, and JSON report output.

Task 3: Added ModelGym with configurable model eval configs and tasks, Harbor-backed task execution, comparison reports with latency/cost/quality scores, and summary rankings.
Task 4: Added agent scenario test infrastructure with embedded scenario recordings, deterministic replay through eval_harbor MockProvider, and assertion aggregation for recorded agent interactions.
